description.summary: This spell functions like Thunder , except it deals 7d6 points of lightning damage + your casting modifier (Intelligence or Charisma) + 1 point per caster level (maximum +20) and inflicts the Static status effect for 1d10 rounds.
description.value: This spell functions like Thunder , except it deals 7d6 points of lightning damage + your casting modifier (Intelligence or Charisma) + 1 point per caster level (maximum +20) and inflicts the Static status effect for 1d10 rounds. A successful Reflex save prevents the status effect from taking effect.
